title: Finite coin-run probability bound
statement: Let $p=(p_i)_{i\ge 0}$ be a sequence of Boolean bits, and define its binary value by $\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{\infty}\mathbf 1_{\{p_i=\mathrm{true}\}}2^{-(i+1)}$. For any $K\ge 0$, the probability that a uniformly chosen length-$K$ Boolean word, scanned against $p$ in order, first differs at a position where the corresponding bit of $p$ is true, is at most this binary value.
